thread:
samir: quick question — noticed a short 503 spike from ~09:12-09:18 in prod (api-gateway). Where's the fastest place to grab traces + correlate infra metrics? want links for the runbook and a suggested alert tweak if we need to quiet noisy bursts.

emily: start with the "API Gateway Errors" grafana dashboard -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/api-gateway-errors (top panel = 5xx by route). For traces, open the APM trace search: https://traces.redwood.internal/search and filter service:api-gateway status:503.

mohit: +1 to those. Quick log pull if you want raw request ids: `kubectl logs -n prod deploy/api-gateway --since=20m | grep "status=503"` then cross-ref X-Request-Id header with traces.

samir: perfect. any quick datadog/sentry queries I can paste?

emily: datadog: `service:api-gateway AND http.status_code:503` in Logs. For metrics panel use `sum:trace.http.errors{service:api-gateway}.as_count()` over 1m. Sentry: search for traces with `http.status_code:503` and sort by highest duration.

jen: tagging runbook and observability ops doc — https://docs.redwood.internal/observability/runbooks/api-503.md (contains triage checklist + common causes: backend overload, upstream timeouts, rate-limits).

samir: thanks. We might need to tune the alert — current prod alert fires for >1% 5xx over 2m, which flagged on this short blip. Suggestions?

mohit: I'd rather avoid lowering sensitivity in general. For short bursts we can add a small cooldown/debounce: require the threshold for 2 consecutive 1m buckets (i.e., sustained 2m) OR increase window to 5m but add a secondary per-route high-count guard. Example: alert if 5xx_rate > 1% for 5m AND total_5xx_count > 10 for 5m. That keeps sensitivity for real issues, ignores tiny spikes.

emily: we can implement as a composite in the alerting rules: `(%5xx > 1% for 5m) AND (sum(5xx_count, 5m) > 10)`. I'll draft the change.

samir: can you link the PR when ready? I'll need to review. Also want a quick dashboard link to show the 09:12 spike for PMs.

emily: PR: https://github.com/redwood/observability/pull/234 (WIP). Dashboard snapshot: https://grafana.redwood.internal/snapshot/xyz123 (time range 09:00-09:30).

rachel: FYI I'm oncall today — happy to approve the alert tweak if the PR includes tests and rollbacks. Small note: add a 3m auto-snooze for the alert so we don't spam the oncall channel if it flips several times.

mohit: good call. I'll add a `for: 3m` and a `recovery_silence: 3m` to the rule. Also adding a per-route tag so we can mute noisy internal clients.

ops-bot: alert-rule-update-notice: observability/alerts/api-gateway-5xx updated (proposed) in branch fix/alert-debounce by mohitops. PR: #234

samir: @mohit @rachel great — once PR is linked I'll review and merge. Everyone: if you have trace IDs from the spike drop them here and I'll attach to the PR for postmortem.

jen: pasted two request ids I found in logs: 7f1a2b4c and d3c9e8aa. They map to traces in APM.

emily: pulled both traces, both show upstream timeout (503 returned by edge after 30s backend timeout). Adding note to runbook: check backend timeout config + circuit-breaker counters.

samir: awesome. I'll close the loop after PR merges. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: alert-rule fix/alert-debounce merged to staging by rachel at 1887654785 (automatic).

rachel: merged and scheduled staged rollout. I'll watch alerts for next 2 hours and report back.

samir: thanks — marking this as resolved for now. If spikes recur I'll re-open.
